title: Industrial Production Index (IPI)
description: Real output of the three main industrial sectors, namely mining, manufacturing and electricity.

fields.name: series
fields.title: Series Type
fields.description: [String] Series type, either absolute values ('abs'), year-on-year growth ('growth_yoy') or month-on-month growth ('growth_mom')

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as the data is at monthly frequency

fields.name: index
fields.title: Index
fields.description: [Float] Quantity of output expressed as an index with base 2015 = 100

fields.name: index_sa
fields.title: Index (sa)
fields.description: [Float] Quantity of output expressed as a seasonally adjusted index with base 2015 = 100

methodology:
The Industrial Production Index (IPI) is designed to measure the production of industrial commodities in the mining, manufacturing, and electricity sectors in real terms (i.e. in terms of output, not sales value). The IPI is produced using the following data:
 - Monthly data on the production of crude oil and natural gas from PETRONAS.
 - Monthly production data for 245 selected industries in the manufacturing sector from the Monthly Manufacturing Survey, which covers establishments with significant sales.
 - Monthly data on the production of crude palm oil, refined palm kernel oil and palm kernel oil from the Malaysian Palm Oil Board (MPOB).
 - Monthly data on the generation of electricity from Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB), Sabah Electricity Sdn. Bhd. (SESB) and Sarawak Energy Berhad (SEB).

 For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/ipi-technotes).
caveat: The most recent 1 year of data may be revised in future releases.
publication: [Index of Industrial Production, May 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/ipi_2026-05), the latest edition of the monthly industrial production statistics published by DOSM.
